input.expected: The second WELCOME5 order by alice is rejected with 400 invalid_promo_code... specifically code promo_already_used.
input.actual: The second order with WELCOME5 by the same user is accepted with 201 and status confirmed.

input.title: GET /events/{id} not-found response does not use the standard error envelope
input.spec_rule: Every error response has the status code listed below and this body shape: `{"error": {"code": "<machine_code>", "message": "<human text>"}}`. ... `GET /events/{id}` — public. `200` with the event, or `404` code `not_found`.
input.actual: Returns 404 with the body {"detail": "Not Found"}, which lacks the required error envelope and code. Unknown routes do use the correct envelope.
